desc: Whatever your mood, our flavoring syrups are designed to be enjoyed in drinks, desserts, and much more. You can also feel good knowing our natural and organic flavored syrups are also kosher, vegan, non-GMO, and gluten-free.

name: Fragrances
desc: An oil is essential because it carries a distinctive scent or essence, of the plant it is extracted from. Although they are generally extracted by distillation, other processes may be utilized including expression or solvent extraction. These natural fragrances and essential oils can be used in perfumes, cosmetics, soaps, and household cleaning products, as well as for flavoring foods and drinks and adding scents to incense, candles, and other products.

name: Massage Oils
desc: Natural massage oil is used to lubricate the skin during a body massage, which allows the masseuse's hands to glide smoothly over the skin of the person being massaged. Massage oils saturate the skin, leaving the skin feeling soft and hydrated after the massage. The skincare oils used during massages are considered massage oils. These natural massage oils are made from plant-sourced ingredients and plant extracts that have therapeutic properties. Massage oils are safe for use on the skin and allow for many therapeutic benefits.

name: Essential Oils
desc: There are many ways to incorporate organic and natural essential oils into your daily routine. Our aromatherapy oils can help relax the senses during wellness activities like yoga or meditation. Add these pure essential oils to a diffuser to give your home an uplifting scent. These diffuser oils are highly concentrated, so a little goes a long way. Use our essential oils for skincare applications when combined with a carrier oil. This helps to dilute the strength of the aromatherapy oil, making it safe to apply topically.

name: Carrier Oils
desc: Self-care is paramount to health and wellness. Carrier oils are great facilitators of self-care. Used to dilute essential oils, they are designed to complement aromatherapy and wellness routines. Carrier oils are also used for crafting custom skincare lines, as well as creating a calming night-time ritual. Either way, our line of high-quality carrier oils is here to guide you towards a balanced life.

name: Fragrance Emulsions
desc: Available as USDA certified organic fragrance emulsions as well, you can add these scented fragrance extracts to your organic skincare and body care products. These water-soluble fragrance emulsions give beauty cosmetics, bath products, and candles a long-lasting aroma, as they help to evenly distribute the scent throughout the product.

name: Fragrance Powders
desc: Nature’s Flavors fragrance powders are designed for easy incorporation into your formulations, allowing you to enhance your products with ease and consistency. name: Fragrance Oils
desc: Our fragrance oils are excellent aromatic oils that are used in a variety of applications. Premium fragrance oils are often highly concentrated and can be diluted with a carrier oil to reduce the potency and make the oil safe for skincare, body care, and hair care applications.

name: Slushy Syrups
desc: Making slushies are easier than ever! With our natural and organic slushy syrups, you can enjoy a wide range of options to satisfy every taste bud. So no matter if you're using a dedicated slushy machine, a blender, or simply manually crushing ice to achieve that perfect slushy consistency, Nature's Flavors ensures the quality and premium taste of your desire!

name: Low-Carb Erythritol Syrups
desc: Sugarless doesn’t have to taste less. By using our low-carb syrups with erythritol, you can avoid sugar spikes and have control over your blood sugar, follow a keto and low-carb goal diet with ease, enjoy flavor with less calories, eliminate artificial additives, and customize your recipes with clean-label options. Our erythritol syrups blend smoothly into hot and cold beverages, mix seamlessly into batters, and pair well with dairy and non-dairy bases. They’re also kosher, gluten-free, and vegan, making them a perfect fit for a wide range of dietary preferences.

name: Pancake Syrups
desc: Sugar-free and certified organic pancake syrups will allow you to start your day with clean and delicious ingredients. Designed with real, authentic ingredients, our pancake syrups provide rich flavors to your breakfast items without synthetic additives and artificial preservatives. No matter if you’re serving your family, guests, or yourself a classic breakfast, or simply looking to spruce up your establishment’s brunch menu, our syrups will bring tremendous satisfaction to your taste buds and nourishment to your health.

name: Powdered Syrups
desc: Powdered syrups are basically liquid syrups dried up, dehydrated then combined with a carrier agent like gum acacia to create a powdered syrup designed to withstand high-heat applications. Easily dissolvable, our natural and organic powdered syrups are ideally used in various applications like dry mixes, pre-made beverage powders, baked goods, and many more. They provide a more portable, scalable option for food manufacturers and beverage developers looking for shelf-stable flavor systems that stay fresh longer.

name: Cocktail Mix Syrups
desc: Cocktail mix syrups are concentrated liquid flavorings used to make your alcoholic beverages flavorful. In order to make delicious cocktails and mocktails, you need to add cocktail mix syrups in your alcoholic drinks for a sweetness and complexity provided only by this specific concentrated liquid flavoring.

name: Italian Soda Syrups
desc: Our flavor experts have developed a line of organic and natural flavored Italian soda syrups used to make refreshing Italian sodas - the perfect summer beverage. The Italian soda syrup flavors are mixed with sparkling water or carbonated soda to create a tasty drink. At Nature’s Flavors, we offer some of the best syrups for Italian sodas. All of our Italian soda flavor syrups are created with organic and natural plant-derived ingredients. The Italian soda syrups are kosher, gluten-free, and vegan. The syrups for Italian sodas do not contain any alcohol, but they can be added to cocktail mixes to flavor alcoholic beverages.

name: Snow Cone Syrups
desc: Our natural and organic snow cone syrups contain sugar, water, and plant-derived ingredients and flavorings. Our flavor chemists never add any artificial ingredients or additives to our products, including the flavored snow cone syrups. You can feel confident using the snow cone flavor syrup, knowing exactly what ingredients are in them. The organic snow cone syrups are made with the best certified organic ingredients. Our flavor chemists use only the finest plant-derived ingredients in our naturally flavored snow cone syrups, so you can enjoy this classic summer treat without worrying about any artificial flavors or additives.

name: Flavored Syrups
desc: Nature’s Flavors formulated flavored syrups with natural and certified organic ingredients in the hopes of delivering vibrant and bold tastes that not only nourish, but also meet the highest standards of clean-label formulation. Our flavored syrups fulfill clean-label demands, perfect for cafes and restaurants who are looking to create more healthful and delicious food menu items.

name: Keto Friendly Flavors
desc: When we say we have keto-friendly flavors, it means we have taken out ALL carbohydrates from our natural flavorings that humans might absorb. These keto flavor extracts have been crafted meticulously and contain natural and organic ingredients from nature. The keto-friendly flavorings and extracts offered by Nature’s Flavors have few to no carbs and contain no sugar. These keto flavors are instead sweetened with our natural sweeteners like erythritol and stevia for a tasty flavor that provides a healthier flavoring alternative with fewer calories.

name: TTB Approved Flavors
desc: TTB approved flavors are flavorings that the Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau (TTB) has authorized for use in alcoholic beverages. These flavors meet the TTB's standards for alcoholic beverage production, ensuring they are safe and meet labeling requirements. Our TTB-approved flavors are ideal for home and commercial use. Whether you are concocting drinks at home or are a professional bartender, mixologist, brewmaster, or wholesale alcoholic beverage manufacturer, you’ll love our collection of sweet and savory TTB-approved flavors that can elevate the flavor profile of your specialty cocktails, craft beers, wine, and spirits.

name: Flavors without Diacetyl
desc: Diacetyl-free flavors refer to extracts, emulsions, oils, and other flavorings that do not use a widely speculated health-adverse chemical called Diacetyl (more commonly found in pop corn) during its formulation. Flavorings that are non-diacetyl instead rely on natural and USDA-certified organic ingredients to create the irresistible flavor notes that people love. Our diacetyl-free flavors are crafted to give you peace of mind and great tasting products, no matter if you’re developing a popcorn seasoning, a nutty cream sauce, or a clean-label creamy dessert.
